limitations.note: The rewrite corrected the prefix to `011` but checked the newly shifted window instead of the pre-edge register, asserting `match` one clock earlier than the original timing.
Changing the shift-register reset value from zeros to ones suppressed startup matches that the original zero-filled window could produce.

The test used the just-updated history and required nine post-reset samples, so its passing result validated the agent’s new timing and startup assumptions rather than checking that the fix preserved the original behavior.
